answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond, call it an onyx deposit, before its votes or attestations count. Spawning a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds, so sybils buy no cheap influence. Any bridge between ledgers must verify a bond is not reused on two chains, and proven misbehavior slashes the stake. Honest reputation grows slowly like a cedar, while fraud burns real capital.
